title: The Summer Courses
institution: The Hague Academy of International Law
about: The Hague Academy of International Law's 2027 Summer Courses at the Peace Palace run in two sessions: Public International Law (5-23 July 2027) and Private International Law (26 July-13 August 2027). Applications, including scholarship requests, are accepted from 1 November 2026 to 31 January 2027.
requirements: Scholarships are limited and based on academic merit
A scholarship can be awarded only once across Summer and Winter Courses
